title: Rutina Diaria de 24 Horas de Influencer de Belleza Japonesa: Collage de Cuadrícula de 12 Fotos
prompt: A photorealistic 12-panel grid collage layout (3 columns x 4 rows) depicting the 24-hour daily routine of a trendy 24-year-old Japanese beauty influencer named Mina. Aspect ratio 3:4. Each panel is a high-quality snapshot with a specific handwritten-style cute Japanese text caption overlay. Cinematic, highly detailed, photorealistic, lifestyle photography. The Japanese text should be legible, cute handwriting style, placed naturally in each frame.
